doc: DebounceOptions configures the debouncing of user input, e.g. when typing text into a field.

1.doc: Disabled must be set to true, to disable the default debouncer logic. This will cause a render roundtrip for each keystroke, so be careful not to break the server or cause UX issues due to UI latencies.
1.name: Disabled

2.doc: Time is in nanoseconds. A zero or omitted value means to enable debounce default logic.
2.name: Time
